clauses.clause: Escape gap on the route for 40 s, pursuers still chase; collapse waves 3 every 9 s; competent run meets ≥ 10 infected on the route (tune), never an empty street. PO: "The entire level is without zombies".
clauses.note: Fresh physical low/high real WASD/mouse/E routes complete without skips or God mode (12/10 deaths over whole level disclosed). Every actual escape-window opening/respawn sets gapUntil−tick=2400ticks/40s: low4 windows,high2. Final physical window reaches cellar within29.033/35.117s; sampled living chase-state pursuers never vanish (min5 low/24 high on final attempt), preserving pursuit while route stays traversable. High successful final physical attempt meets≥64 distinct chasing infected within12m; low ordinary mortal complete native final attempt meets16 living visible admitted infected within12m. Native count resets on every actual gapUntil change, not the nonexistent restore event; five low attempts count38/28/16/35/16. Low native finishes with10 deaths, high native600s probe times out with22; no high native completion is claimed. Collapse scheduling measured every540ticks/9s, base3 per edge (low tier rounds to2,three edges): requests6 low/9 high; actual all-edge admissions across full9s windows have minima4 low (21 windows) /3 high (41 windows). Physical full windows also admit≥3; no requested-only count substituted for admission count. Four original1280×720 captures opened: low16334 shows a lone nearby attacker and red radar contacts in the escape street, low19060 shows cellar hide; high13715 shows dense live attackers among corpses at escape start, high16423 shows successful cellar hide. This establishes route traversal, continued chase, measured contact floor and live admissions; it does not assert that an attacker stays within12m at every instant, or pass a separate death/time budget.
